analysis.title: Neon Virtual Reality Landing Page
analysis.notes: A black interface is framed by saturated purple atmosphere, with a large luminous spherical 3D object dominating the right side and angular display typography anchoring the left. Thin dividers, compact navigation, a gradient call-to-action, and a translucent media card create a polished futuristic product-landing composition.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a futuristic 3D hero visual on a deep black background: a large abstract spherical core made of concentric luminous segmented rings, glowing electric blue, violet, and hot magenta from within. Surround it with irregular transparent black polygonal shells and a few thin orbital bands, with subtle reflections, volumetric bloom, floating angular fragments, and soft purple atmospheric haze. Compose the orb large on the right with ample dark negative space on the left for interface copy. High-contrast cinematic product render, polished sci-fi landing-page art direction, no text, logos, or recognizable characters.
